subject: Spend ownership check-in and procurement/security contacts
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novium.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & quick asks from today's call

Alex — really appreciate the time today. Quick recap from my side and three small asks so we can keep momentum into procurement: 

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for batch drug-similarity pipelines (expected 50–75M tokens/month in production).
- Decision criteria: predictable throughput, data controls (VPC option), and measurable cost delta vs. current infra.
- Timeline: aiming for a procurement decision in Q4 (you mentioned end-of-year budget window).

Asks
1) Can you confirm who is the formal budget owner / signer for projects like this (title + email)? We want to make sure pricing and ROI get to the right person.
2) Please loop in procurement and whoever owns the security questionnaire so we can send the appropriate evidence and SSO/KMS details.
3) Any constraints on contract review timing (e.g., 2–3 week procurement cycles) we should be aware of?

I attached a short mutual action plan (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps milestones, owners, and a rough timeline — feel free to edit. If it helps, I can draft an LOE + ballpark SOW next week and a simple pricing snapshot so Dave/finance can see unit economics side-by-side.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm budget owner + procurement/security contacts; 2) I send SOW + pricing by end of week; 3) schedule a 30-min alignment with all stakeholders.

Thanks again — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novium.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novium.io, Clara Li <clara.li@novium.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & quick asks from today's call

Thanks Vivek — good recap and appreciated the MAP. To answer your asks: 

1) Budget owner/signer: Dave Thompson, CFO (dave.thompson@novium.io). He signs anything >$50k and will want the unit economics + a clear owner for runbook/ops.
2) Procurement: procurement@novium.io handles contracts/POs; procurement lead is a rotating mailbox but they manage timelines and DocuSign routing.
3) Security/contact for questionnaire: Clara Li (clara.li@novium.io), Director of Infrastructure Security; she handles SOC/Security questionnaires and SSO/KMS discussions.

Timing: We're targeting a Q4 procurement window but procurement wants a 2–4 week review period once legal has the SOW + T&Cs. Dave will expect to see a simple 12-month cost projection and the SLA/uptime language called out.

If you can send a short SOW + pricing and the security questionnaire answers for Clara, I can loop them in. Happy to schedule a 30-min sync next week — cc'ing Clara and procurement.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novium.io>, Dave Thompson <dave.thompson@novium.io>
Cc: Clara Li <clara.li@novium.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@novium.io
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & quick asks from today's call

Alex — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Hi Dave / Clara — nice to e-meet. Quick note on next steps from our side: 

- We'll send a concise SOW (4–5 pages) and a 12-month cost projection that shows expected token volumes, projected monthly spend, and an ROI note vs. current infra.
- Ben will include recommended pricing tiers and optional Dedicated capacity pricing (if you'd prefer committed throughput).
- Clara — we'll also send completed answers to your security questionnaire and a short tech note on how we handle KMS/SSO + logging. If you prefer, we can share a redacted SOC2 report and a short network diagram.

Proposed timing:
- Today: I upload the MAP to the HubSpot deal and add the attachments (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx + Novium_Security_Questionnaire.pdf).
- EOW (Fri): SOW + pricing snapshot to Dave + procurement + Clara.
- Next week: 30-minute alignment call with Dave + Clara (please suggest a 2–3 slot window).

Scheduling link: https://calendar.redwood.company/meet/vivek/30min (feel free to pick a time)

If that plan looks good I’ll proceed. Marissa — can you own the procurement thread and DocuSign logistics? Ben — can you draft the pricing snapshot and send to me by Thursday?

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: Novium_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: procurement/DocuSign + pricing tasks (Novium)

Vivek / Ben — internal thread to confirm commitments following Alex's reply.

Action items I picked up:
- I will own procurement coordination and DocuSign routing once the SOW + T&Cs are finalized. I'll create an initial DocuSign envelope and pre-populate Novium's procurement mailbox.
- I will add the MAP to the HubSpot deal and tag Dave Thompson on the timeline.

Ben — please get me the pricing snapshot (Committed vs. On-demand) + the one-page LOE by end of day Thursday so I can attach to the envelope.
Vivek — when you send the SOW, include the SLA uptime language and an explicit cancellation clause (standard Redwood language is fine). Also include the SLA credits table for Dave/finance to review.

I'll follow up with procurement@novium.io once the doc set is ready.

Thanks — Marissa

--

Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
